note: Wording of the applicant screens (City permits entry, chooser, form, receipt, My permits). Fictional ACME demonstration text. It states no fee, limit or timing of its own: limits come from the published rules, timings from the permit type, and every sentence describes only what the application really does.
footer_note: Fictional City of Acme website for a software demonstration; every person, address, rule, fee and permit record shown here is synthetic.

what_you_need.title: Contact details
what_you_need.text: Your name and an email address. A phone number is optional.

what_you_need.title: The property
what_you_need.text: The address of the property where the work will happen.

what_you_need.title: A project description
what_you_need.text: What you plan to build or change, with the sizes the form asks for.

what_you_need.title: The documents asked for
what_you_need.text: Each project type lists its own documents. You can add a file now or say you sent it to the City separately.

document_purposes.site_plan: Shows where the work sits on the property and its distance from the property lines.
document_purposes.material_spec: Names the materials the structure will be built from.
document_purposes.construction_plans: The drawings the reviewer checks the building work against.
document_purposes.energy_compliance_form: Records how the building meets the energy rules.
document_purposes.floor_plan: Shows the layout of the space the work affects.
document_purposes.fire_suppression_plan: Shows the fire sprinkler or suppression design.
document_purposes.business_license_copy: Confirms the business that applies is registered.
document_purposes.sign_drawing: Shows the size, wording and look of the sign.
document_purposes.owner_authorization: Confirms the property owner agrees to the work.
document_purposes.traffic_control_plan: Shows how traffic and walkers are kept safe during the work.
document_purposes.insurance_certificate: Shows the insurance that covers the work.
document_purposes.contractor_license_copy: Confirms the contractor who does the work is licensed.
document_purposes.change_of_use_notice: Describes how the use of the space will change.
document_purposes.property_survey: Shows the boundaries and features of the lot.
document_purposes.legal_description: Gives the legal description of the land.
document_purposes.hardship_statement: Explains why the rule causes a hardship for this property.
document_purposes.photographs: Shows the property as it is today.
document_purposes.supporting_document: Anything else that supports the application.

rule_hints.DF-2: Side and rear yard fences: {limit} ft at most ({citation}).
rule_hints.DF-3: Deck distance from the rear property line: at least {limit} ft ({citation}).
rule_hints.DF-4: A deck higher than {limit} ft above the ground needs a footing inspection and guard rail ({citation}).

next_step.draft: Finish the form and submit it when it is ready. Nothing has been sent to the City yet.
next_step.submitted: The City's intake agent checks your application for missing items and unreadable documents, then it goes to a reviewer. Nothing is needed from you while it waits.
next_step.needs_information: Respond to the City's request. Your answer sends the application back to the City to check again.
next_step.revisions_requested: Respond to the City's request. Your answer sends the application back to the City to check again.
next_step.ready_for_review: The application is waiting for a reviewer. Nothing is needed from you.
next_step.under_review: A reviewer is looking at the application. If the City needs something from you it appears here as a request.
next_step.approved: The application is approved. The permit is issued once the City has recorded the fees as paid.
next_step.issued: Your permit is issued. Download it and keep a copy.
next_step.denied: The City decided not to approve this application. Read the decision note, or start a new application.
next_step.withdrawn: This application was withdrawn. Start a new application if you still want the permit.
next_step.returned: The City returned this application. Start a new application with the corrections.
next_step.archived: The City archived this application. Ask permit services if you have a question about it.

discretionary_note: Only a person or the board decides this kind of application.
next_step_empty: Start an application to begin. Your applications will be listed here.
target_sentence: The City's service target for this permit type is {days} days. The City works to that target and does not promise it for any one application.

request_titles.unreadable: A document could not be read

receipt.title: Application received
receipt.next_step: The City's intake agent checks it next, then a person at the City decides. Nothing is approved automatically.
receipt.copy_note: The copy is a printable web page of what you submitted. It is not a permit.
